heading: INT. MRS. ALDRIDGE'S PORTRAIT STUDIO, PHILADELPHIA - 1867 - DAY

units.text: INT. MRS. ALDRIDGE'S PORTRAIT STUDIO, PHILADELPHIA - 1867 - DAY
Skylight, painted backdrops, a brass camera on a tripod.
Five people wait in a row of chairs.
Do we stand or sit?
units.name: AUGUSTA

units.text: Sit, you goose. We're paying by the plate.
units.name: LEOPOLD

units.text: Papa says we mustn't smile. Smiling is for children and fools.
units.name: BENEDIKT

units.text: Papa has never been photographed.
units.name: WILHELMINA

units.text: He says it steals the soul.
units.name: BENEDIKT

units.text: It steals a dollar and a half, which is worse.
units.name: CASIMIR

units.text: Casimir, hush.
units.name: LEOPOLD

units.text: Willa, is my collar straight?
units.name: AUGUSTA

units.text: It is crooked, but the crookedness suits you.
units.name: WILHELMINA

units.text: That is not an answer.
units.name: AUGUSTA

units.text: It is the only kind she gives.
units.name: CASIMIR

units.text: Does anybody know how long we must hold still?
units.name: BENEDIKT

units.text: Ten seconds. Mrs. Aldridge said so.
units.name: LEOPOLD

units.text: I once held still for a whole sermon.
units.name: CASIMIR

units.text: You fell asleep, Cas.
units.name: WILHELMINA

units.text: That is the same thing, only more honest.
units.name: CASIMIR

units.text: Leopold, you will not tell Mother we came.
units.name: AUGUSTA

units.text: Of course not.
units.name: LEOPOLD

units.text: She will see the photograph.
units.name: BENEDIKT

units.text: By then it will be too late to be cross.
units.name: LEOPOLD

units.text: And if she cries?
units.name: WILHELMINA

units.text: Then we shall give her a copy to cry on.
units.name: LEOPOLD

units.text: Hush. Hush, here comes Mrs. Aldridge.
units.name: AUGUSTA

units.text: Do not smile.
units.name: CASIMIR

units.text: I am not smiling.
units.name: BENEDIKT

units.text: You are all of you smiling.
units.name: WILHELMINA

units.text: Then let us be fools, and have it done.
units.name: LEOPOLD
